assessment: Alpha.564 fixes a genuine CompressedObjectUpdate 64-byte partial-header bug. OGL formerly inserted unknown phantom prims and could transplant old parent/attachment/mesh/TextureEntry to a newly allocated different UUID sharing the previous LocalID. A new active-region WorldModel apply_object_compressed_partial requires exact existing LocalID+UUID+PCode and validated finite pose, updates only State and transform, preserves parent, mesh, all GPU texture source metadata. State=0 correctly detaches. Real 64-byte compressed packet decoded then integrated with current WorldModel in C++ tests, with foreign-UUID negative check; Firestorm animated OpenGL attachment framebuffer changes when partial source pose moves. Upstream OpenGenesisLINK main 95c2133 changed only Hypergrid stats API. Authenticated real NexVerse skin/COF/outfit and simulator-confirmed WASD end-to-end still open/unverified, weighted 38.65 percent (39 rounded).
